summary: Focused retest of Audit Logs Clear-filter fix (previously MEDIUM bug in iteration_4) plus sanity checks on Apply and Export CSV. All 3 checks passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_5 verified: (1) Clear-filter single-click fix — after applying 2099 range that empties table, ONE click on audit-clear-filter-btn cleared both date inputs AND repopulated 26 rows without needing a manual re-apply. (2) Apply valid range (last 30 days) returned 26 rows. (3) audit-export-btn triggered GET /api/audit-logs/export with 200 status and Content-Type text/csv; charset=utf-8. Backend not re-tested per instructions (12/12 green in iteration_4).
rca of the issue: Previously the Clear button relied on a useCallback closure that captured stale start/end state, so clearing the state and immediately calling load() ran with the still-populated future range. Fix in AuditLogs.js changes load() to accept explicit (s,e) args; Clear now calls load('','') so a single click empties inputs AND fetches unfiltered rows atomically. Verified fixed.
